cards.text: Status, diffs, branches, commits, merges and history.

cards.title: .NET
cards.text: Build, test, run, restore and list packages.

cards.title: Shell
cards.text: Python, PowerShell and bash, on the composition's runners.

cards.title: Web

cards.title: Paymo
cards.text: Time entries, tasks, projects and summaries, on its own key.

cards.title: Azure DevOps
cards.text: Work items, sprints and team queries, on its own settings.
